step.stage: Set the stage for each scene
step.rehearse: Play the whole film’s code, twice, and check both runs match
step.frames: Draw each scene twice, and check every frame matches
step.state: Play the film on each renderer, and check every frame’s scene matches
step.undo: Undo every change, and redo them
step.save: Save the production and open it again
problem.noLogline: The storyboard has no logline or synopsis.
problem.noSays: Each scene should have something to say in its code.
problem.filmStopped: The film stopped with a problem: {words}.
problem.order: The scenes didn’t play in their running order.
problem.filmDiffered: The film played differently the second time.
problem.sceneDiffered: Scene {scene} played differently the second time, from frame {frame}.
problem.noMp4: The export didn’t make an MP4 file.
problem.exportDiffered: The export came out differently the second time, from frame {frame}.
problem.undoLabel: The next undo should be “{expected}”, not “{actual}”.
problem.undoAll: Undoing everything did not bring back the film as it was.
problem.redoAll: Redoing everything did not bring back the changes.
problem.wontOpen: The saved film wouldn’t open again.
problem.openedDifferently: The film opened differently from how it was saved.
problem.savedDifferently: Saving the same film twice gave different files.
standIn.noMp4: checks that 150 frames come out the same every time; no MP4 is made here.
standIn.oneRenderer: this device draws with {renderer} only, so each frame was checked twice on it.
report.heading: StoryStage self-test, {when}
